chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 396: Han Li's First Look at the Epic Heaven Star City
chapter_meta_description: Han Li arrives at the legendary Heaven Star City, the colossal hub of the Chaotic Star Sea. He navigates its unique entry system and hires a mortal guide, marking a new phase in his cultivation journey.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 396 - The Giant City Revealed
og_description: Experience the awe-inspiring scale of Heaven Star City as Han Li steps into the largest cultivation hub in the Chaotic Star Sea. A new city, new rules, and new opportunities await.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch 396: Han Li hits the big city.
twitter_description: Han Li finally arrives at Heaven Star City. Giant walls, spirit stone bureaucracy, and a hired mortal guide. The cultivation world just got a lot bigger.

lore_anchors.definition: The number one city and central hub of the Chaotic Star Sea, built in spirals around a towering central mountain on a massive island. It functions as a neutral ground for cultivators of all factions.
A speed-focused flying artifact owned by Han Li, crafted from Ink Flood Dragon materials.

The financial system of the cultivation world where spirit stones serve as both currency and energy source. Prices in a major hub like Heaven Star City highlight the vast wealth disparity between cultivator classes.
The third major realm of cultivation in RMJI, signifying a massive leap in power, status, and lifespan. Cultivators at this level are treated with automatic respect and privilege in most cities.
A magical token issued by Heaven Star City to track residents and visitors. Blue rings are for temporary stays; red rings are for permanent residents and are bound to the owner's blood essence.
A common sight in cultivation cities, these are ordinary humans who earn spirit stones by providing local knowledge and navigation services to visiting cultivators.
